defs.def: to use your hands, arms or body in order to make sb/sth move forward or away from you; to move part of your body into a particular position 推动（人或物）；移动（身体部位）

ex.s: Society pushes us to specialize, to become experts.
ex.t: 社会推动我们去专业化成为专家。

ex.s: Less traffic at 9:37am could push it down to 135.
ex.t: 9:37车流量较少时，可能会降到135秒。

ex.s: He stood on his back legs and pushed at the wooden fence posts.
ex.t: 它用后腿站起来，推着木栅栏的柱子。

ex.s: From the experience I learned a lot about how the attitude of the leader can （18）     the members of a team． Instead of seeing my boys as losers， I pushed and （19）     them． I helped them to see themselves（20）     ， and they built themselves into winners．
ex.t: 从这次经历中，我学到很多关于领导者态度如何（18）___团队成员。我没有把孩子们看作失败者，而是推动并（19）___他们。我帮他们（20）___看待自己，他们把自己打造成赢家。

ex.s: In the beginning, what drove the author to push forward with the research plan?
ex.t: 起初，是什么推动作者继续推进研究计划？

ex.s: It has to be: you’re pushing your body to its physical limits, which leads to significant discomfort.
ex.t: 所有营地课程都根据儿童多种学习方式设计了适龄活动。

ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." We should especially recognize our children's efforts to push themselves and work hard to achieve a goal, "says Donahue, author of Parenting Without Fear: Letting Go of Worry and Focusing on What Really Matters.
ex.t: 如果赞美是真诚的，并且专注于努力而不是结果，那么你可以像孩子做一些值得口头奖励的事情一样频繁地给予赞美。” 我们应当特别承认我们的孩子努力推动自己并努力实现一个目标，即“无恐惧地养育子女：让忧心忡忡地去关注真正重要的事情”的作者多纳休(Donahue)说。

ex.s: As new technologies take on increasingly humanlike qualities, there’s been a push to make them genderless.
ex.t: 随着新技术越来越多地呈现人类特征，人们一直在推动让它们变得性别中立。

ex.s: Then I created the Shy and Mighty Society, a space for shy people like me to shine, and in the process of helping others, I could also push myself forward, bit by bit.
ex.t: 于是我创建了“羞怯而强大协会”，一个让像我一样害羞的人发光的地方；在帮助别人的过程中，我也能一点点推动自己前进。

defs.def: to use force to move past sb/sth using your hands, arms, etc. 推进（道路）；挤开

ex.s: Housing development pushed into the woods.
ex.t: 住宅开发区向林地推进。

defs.def: to affect sth so that it reaches a particular level or state 推动；促使（达到某程度或状态）

ex.s: Ortiz, who pushed for the state's 2001 ban on hand-held devices by drivers.
ex.t: Ortiz 推动了该州2001年禁止司机使用手持设备的法规。

ex.s: She says that Western culture already pushes people to look for the silver lining behind every cloud.
ex.t: 她说西方文化已经促使人们在每一朵乌云背后寻找一线希望。

ex.s: Most of us would assume that urban development and climate change are responsible for pushing the animals out of their natural habitats.
ex.t: 然而，并不是所有人都对幽默有同样的看法。

ex.s: By 9:33am, a burst of additional traffic might push it to 145 seconds.
ex.t: 到上午9:33，一阵额外的车流可能把它推高到145秒。

defs.def: to press a switch, button, etc., for example in order to make a machine start working 按；揿；摁
to persuade or encourage sb to do sth that they may not want to do 说服；劝解；鼓励；敦劝
to make sb work hard 鞭策；督促
to put pressure on sb and make them angry or upset 迫使 … 生气（或不安）
to try hard to persuade people to accept or agree with a new idea, buy a new product, etc. 力劝 … 接受；推销
to sell illegal drugs 贩卖毒品
to move forward quickly through an area 挺进；推进

ex.s: But my need for independence drove me to push forward with my research plan.
ex.t: 但我对独立的需求驱使我继续推进我的研究计划。

defs.def: to move away from land in a boat, or from the side of a swimming pool, etc. （乘船）离岸；离开（游泳池边等）
an act of pushing sth/sb 推；搡

ex.s: He pushed a chair onto the balcony, and climbed up   59   （see）them.
ex.t: 他把一把椅子推到阳台上，爬上去（第59空，see）他们。

ex.s: But as Aristotle observed over 2,000 years ago, actions pushed to their extreme turn into disasters.
ex.t: 但正如亚里士多德在2000多年前观察到的，推向极端的行为会变成灾难。

ex.s: Whether I'm at the gym or on the road, my nervous energy pushes me through mile one.
ex.t: 无论是在健身房还是在路上，我那紧张的能量都推着我跑完第一英里。

ex.s: My legs carried me to that door, and I pushed it open.
ex.t: 我的腿把我带到那扇门前，我把它推开了。

ex.s: Alistair pushed himself towards the finish line in the burning heat, but as he came round the corner, he saw his brother about to fall onto the track.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔在燃烧的热量中将自己推向终点线，但当他来到拐角处时，他看见他的兄弟即将掉到赛道上。

ex.s: I’m being pushed around quite a bit, in fact.
ex.t: 事实上，我被推来推去得挺厉害的。

defs.def: a large and determined military attack 进攻；攻势；挺进
a determined effort to achieve sth 矢志的追求；坚定的努力

ex.s: their new appearance and lower pricesB. the push of the local organizations
ex.t: 它们焕然一新的外观和更低的价格 B. 地方组织的推动

defs.def: encouragement to do sth 鼓励；激励
to dismiss sb/to be dismissed from your job （被）解雇，炒鱿鱼
to end a romantic relationship with sb; to be told that a romantic relationship with sb is over 与某人结束恋爱关系；把（恋人）甩掉；被甩

ex.s: People in Thailand generally use their forks only to push food onto their spoons.
ex.t: 泰国人通常只用叉子把食物拨到勺子上。

ex.s: Set your alarm clock an hour early and push yourself to work out!
ex.t: 把闹钟调早一小时，逼自己去锻炼！

ex.s: Pushing their children too hard.
ex.t: 把孩子逼得太紧。

ex.s: Alistair then pushed his brother over the line.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔随后把弟弟推过了终点线。
